headline: A Baroque Opera Written By a Female Composer Feels Ripped From the Headlines
context: The Paris Opera production of “Ercole Amante” (“Hercules in Love”), a rediscovered 1707 work by the female composer Antonia Bembo, leans into contemporary themes of coercion and consent.
